description: List the apps published by one developer. Google Play: by developer name as returned by other tools (e.g. "Wikimedia Foundation"). App Store: by developer_id from get_app or search_apps with store=app_store (a developer name also works; it is looked up by search).

country.description: Optional two-letter ISO 3166 store country code. Defaults to US.

developer.description: Developer name exactly as shown in the store, e.g. "Wikimedia Foundation".

developer_id.description: App Store only: numeric developer id, e.g. 310634000 (returned as developer_id by other tools).

store.description: Which store: google_play (Android, default) or app_store (iPhone/iPad).

name: get_developer_apps
title: Get a developer's apps
